# preview: `PreviewOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout preview FILE -o out.png --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `preview`: what was rendered, and where it went.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/preview.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/preview.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema preview`.

## Types

### ImagePreview

Details of an image preview.

PNG pixel `(px, py)` inside `plot_area` shows full-resolution source pixel
`x = source_origin.x + (px - plot_area.x) * source_per_pixel`,
`y = source_origin.y + (py - plot_area.y) * source_per_pixel_y` (left/top edges of the PNG
pixel), whatever pyramid level, downsample or region was drawn; the ruler labels use the same
numbers, so a `region` read off them can be passed straight back.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Image index. |
| `level` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Pyramid level read (0 = full resolution). |
| `source_width` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Plane size at that level. |
| `source_height` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Plane height at that level. |
| `region` | [`Region`](#region) or `null` |  | The rectangle drawn, in the pixel coordinates of `level`, when a region was asked for. |
| `downsample` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Block size of the averaging downsample (1 = none). |
| `c` | array of `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channels, z-planes and time points used. |
| `z` | array of `integer` (uint32) | yes | Z indices used. |
| `t` | array of `integer` (uint32) | yes | Time indices used. |
| `projection` | `string` or `null` |  | `max-z` or `max-t` for a maximum-intensity projection. |
| `composite` | `boolean` | yes | True when channels were blended into one colour image. |
| `rgb` | `boolean` | yes | True when the planes are RGB (samples_per_pixel 3). |
| `contrast` | `string` | yes | Contrast rule applied (`auto` resolved to what it did, e.g. `percentile:0.1,99.9`). |
| `lut` | `string` | yes | `gray`, `channel-color` or `rgb`. |
| `channels` | array of [`PreviewChannel`](#previewchannel) | yes | One entry per channel drawn. |
| `axes` | `boolean` |  | True when the picture is framed by coordinate rulers (labelled in full-resolution pixels), with a scale bar when the pixel size is known. |
| `grid` | `boolean` |  | True when grid lines were drawn over the data at the ruler ticks. |
| `plot_area` | [`Region`](#region) |  | The data's rectangle inside the PNG, in PNG pixels (the whole PNG without rulers). |
| `source_origin` | [`SourcePoint`](#sourcepoint) |  | Full-resolution source coordinate of the plot area's top-left corner. |
| `source_per_pixel` | `number` (double) |  | Full-resolution source pixels per PNG pixel, horizontally (pyramid level scale × `downsample`). |
| `source_per_pixel_y` | `number` (double) |  | Full-resolution source pixels per PNG pixel, vertically (equal to `source_per_pixel` up to the rounding of pyramid level sizes). |
| `full_res_region` | [`Region`](#region) |  | The full-resolution (level 0) rectangle the plot area shows: pass it, or a part of it, back as `region` to zoom. |
| `scale_bar` | [`ScaleBar`](#scalebar) or `null` |  | The scale bar drawn, when the physical pixel size is known. |

### Region

A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Left edge (column of the first pixel). |
| `y` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Top edge (row of the first pixel). |
| `width` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Width in pixels (at least 1). |
| `height` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Height in pixels (at least 1). |

### PreviewChannel

One channel of an image preview.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | C index. |
| `name` | `string` or `null` |  | Channel name, if recorded. |
| `color` | `string` | yes | Display colour `#RRGGBB` (`#FFFFFF` with the gray LUT). |
| `color_source` | `string` | yes | Where the colour came from: `file` (`channels[].color`), `wavelength`, `palette` or `lut`. |
| `display_min` | `number` (double) | yes | Sample value shown as black. |
| `display_max` | `number` (double) | yes | Sample value shown at full brightness. |

### SourcePoint

A point in full-resolution (level 0) source pixel coordinates.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `number` (double) | yes | Column (may be fractional on a downsampled pyramid level). |
| `y` | `number` (double) | yes | Row. |

### ScaleBar

The scale bar drawn under an image preview.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | `number` (double) | yes | Length as labelled (e.g. `50`). |
| `unit` | `string` | yes | Unit of the label: `nm`, `µm` or `mm`. |
| `length_um` | `number` (double) | yes | Length in µm. |
| `pixels` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Length in PNG pixels. |

### TracePreview

### XAxis

The horizontal axis of a trace or spectrum preview (the labels at its two ends).

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `quantity` | `string` | yes | `time`, `chemical_shift`, `mz`, `sample`, … (the reader's `extra.axis.quantity` when set). |
| `unit` | `string` | yes | `s`, `min`, `ppm`, `m/z`, … (empty for sample indices). |
| `first` | `number` (double) | yes | Value at the left edge. |
| `last` | `number` (double) | yes | Value at the right edge (smaller than `first` for NMR chemical shift, which runs right to left). |

### TracePreviewChannel

One channel of a trace preview.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channel index. |

| `unit` | `string` or `null` |  | Physical unit of the samples. |
| `color` | `string` | yes | Line colour `#RRGGBB`. |
